objectives.description: Confirm lean not active in this repo (.claude-extensions.json)
Confirm 4 touched files are deploy-carried by manifest.json provides.*
Record lean-active consumers and confirm which carry the broken string, read-only
Do NOT write into any consumer repository

notes: Divergence from plan's Scope Hypothesis: plan asserted 3 lean-active consumer repos (BimodalLogic, cslib, Logos/Theory). check-consumer-freshness.sh --stale-only found 5 lean-registered consumers: BimodalLogic, cslib, Logos/Theory, Logos/Hardware, and Philosophy/Papers/PossibleWorlds. Of these, 3 (BimodalLogic, Logos/Theory, Philosophy/Papers/PossibleWorlds) are STALE by exactly 1 lean-extension commit and confirmed (grep) to carry the broken empty-vector string at the same line numbers as pre-fix source. The other 2 (cslib, Logos/Hardware) report CANNOTVERIFY and their deployed lean-implementation-agent.md contains no 'lake-build-guard' reference at all -- a larger, unrelated drift, out of scope to characterize further here.
